column1: # Outcomes of unreadable words of cam in the heartbeat cam/heartbeats/<name> (V/01.2 N1.4) for the subsystem readers; a wholly unreadable heartbeat is the Platform family heartbeats. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.

column3: a camera element not in form: a trouble of this camera, not of the pass — the subscription source is not taken from this element, the talk — 503 unavailable, not 404 no speaker (V/03.3 N1.2a); the other cameras of the pass go on
the holder's heartbeat is unreadable: a trouble of this camera, not of the pass — the source of its subscription is not taken, the other cameras of the pass go on

live_shm or live_url of a camera element not in form: not read, rather than absent — the source kind does not change (do not switch to RTSP), an open source is held, one not open is not opened, reason «cam heartbeat unreadable: <field>»; the next heartbeat — again
the holder's heartbeat is unreadable: the camera of this pass gets no new source, an open one is held; the other recordings of the pass go on

live_shm or live_url of a stream element not in form (both — live_shm) or another violation of the element: not read, rather than absent — the kind does not change, an open source is held, one not open — waiting, reason «cam heartbeat unreadable: <field>»; the next heartbeat — again
the holder's heartbeat is unreadable: the detector's source does not change, one not open — waiting, reason «cam heartbeat unreadable: heartbeat»; the other detectors of the pass go on

index_url or coverage of a camera element not in form: not read, rather than absent — the hole of this span waits (waiting, reason «cam heartbeat unreadable: <field>»), «the device has none» is not set; the next heartbeat — again
the holder's heartbeat is unreadable: the holes that are checked at the device wait (waiting); the other segments of the plan go on

coverage, index_url or playback_url of a camera element not in form: not read, rather than absent — the frontier stands, waiting, reason «cam heartbeat unreadable: <field>», oldest/newest are not reset; the next heartbeat — again
the holder's heartbeat is unreadable: the holder is not found on this pass — waiting, the frontier stands; the cursor is not reset
can of a camera element not in form: not read, rather than absent, and not «cannot» — the scenario works, unchecked (not unfit)
the holder's heartbeat is unreadable: the device has said nothing — the scenario works, unchecked
